headword: {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}

definitions.explanation: The lowest hourly wage that employers are legally required to pay workers, as set by law. In Japan, minimum wages are set at both the national and prefectural level, with rates varying by region.

examples.japanese: {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。

⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: This year's minimum wage exceeded 1,000 yen on the national average.

examples.japanese: {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since the minimum wage differs by prefecture, there are regional disparities.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん} is set per ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ (prefecture), with Tokyo typically having the highest rate. The rate is reviewed annually by the {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}{審議会|しんぎかい} (Minimum Wage Council). Often abbreviated as {最賃|さいちん} in casual speech and news headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the minimum wage
- {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}{法|ほう}: Minimum Wage Act
- ⟦{地域別|ちいきべつ}→地域別：26576_chiikibetsu⟧{最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}: regional minimum wage
- {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work at minimum wage
